notes: ἐνώπιον takes the whole *in the presence of* frame headed on *presence* under rule 71, no article standing in the phrase to claim a determiner.
ἔσται σοι δόξα is recast as *shalt thou have glory*; σοι takes the English subject word and ἔσται the auxiliary and *have*, headed on the lexical verb under rule 17.
σοι after συνανακειμένων takes *with thee* under rule 106's dative arm, the ASV having written an English verb word of its own for the compound.
